gloss: to appear in a photo; to be caught on camera

definitions.gloss: to appear in a photo or video unintentionally; to be caught on camera
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone appearing in a photograph, video, or reflection, often unintentionally or as a background element.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A stranger has appeared in the photo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}んでしまった。
examples.english: A car ended up appearing in the background.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was discovered that a suspicious person had been caught on the security camera.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧ (to be photographed, to appear in an image) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of something entering or getting into the frame.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}む: to appear in a photograph
- ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}む: to appear in the background
- ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}む: to be caught on camera
- ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{写|うつ}り{込|こ}む: to appear in the mirror

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧: to be photographed, to appear — more neutral; simply means appearing in an image without the nuance of unintentionally getting into the frame
- {映|うつ}り{込|こ}む: to be reflected into — uses the kanji for reflection; often for reflections in glass, water, or mirrors

USAGE:
Often used with ～てしまう to express the unintended nature of the appearance. Also common in discussions of privacy and photography etiquette in Japan.
